description: List the audio library in your workspace: recordings, uploads and generated speech, each with an id, category, filename, content type, size, duration, when it was created and the id of what it belongs to (associatedId, e.g. a run). Takes optional filters: `category` or `categories` (comma-separated), `associatedId` (all audio for one run or job), `search` (part of the name, any case), `dateFrom` / `dateTo`, `sourceType` (recorded, uploaded or generated), `sortDirection` (asc or desc), `limit` and `cursor`. Use when: the user asks what recordings or uploaded prompts they have, or whether a run has audio. Returns metadata only, never the audio or a link to it: the person plays or downloads it in the web app. Read-only. Needs audio:read.

associatedId.description:
Filter to audio owned by a specific parent entity (e.g. a `runId`). Note this
query uses a cross-workspace GSI; callers should only pass ids they obtained
from other workspace-scoped responses. Mutually exclusive with the
categories/search/date-range/cursor path.

categories.description:
Comma-separated list of categories (e.g. `voice,test,map`). Presence of this
param (or `search`/`dateFrom`/`dateTo`/`sourceType`/`cursor`) activates the
cursor-paginated full-history query path.

category.description:
Bucket used by the upload-URL handler to derive the S3 key. Audio files
for test runs live under `tests/`, mapping recordings under `maps/`, voice
profiles under `voices/`, and transcript audio under `transcripts/`.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response's `nextCursor`.

search.description:
Case-insensitive substring match against filename, computed display name, and
description — searched server-side across the full paginated history, not just
the current page.

sortDirection.description: Native `createdAt` order. Default matches pre-fix behaviour (newest-first).

name: listAudio

outputSchema.description:
Response for `GET /audio`. May be filtered by `category` (workspace-wide for that
category) or `associatedId` (cross-workspace search by parent entity id, used by
the tester to fetch audio for a specific run).

items.description:
Audio metadata record returned by `GET /audio`, `GET /audio/{id}`. The
bytes themselves live in S3 — fetch via `GET /audio/download-url?id=`.

associatedId.description:
Owning entity id — `runId` for `test`/`map` category, `voiceId` for `voice`
category. Defaults to the audio id when no parent is supplied at upload time.

category.description:
Bucket used by the upload-URL handler to derive the S3 key. Audio files
for test runs live under `tests/`, mapping recordings under `maps/`, voice
profiles under `voices/`, and transcript audio under `transcripts/`.

contentType.description: MIME type captured at upload time.

createdBy.description: User id that initiated the upload.

durationSecs.description: Audio duration in seconds (optional — may be 0 or absent).

expiresAt.description:
Optional TTL (epoch seconds). Audio with `expiresAt` will be auto-deleted by
DynamoDB TTL — present only on ephemeral/test audio.

filename.description: Original client-supplied filename (sanitised for the S3 key).

format.description: Lowercase file extension derived from filename. Optional.

metadata.description: Arbitrary client-supplied metadata captured at upload time.

s3Key.description:
S3 object key inside the audio bucket. Treat as opaque and never rebuild it from
other fields: new uploads get a key that is unique per upload, while rows created
before that change keep their original key.

sampleRate.description: Sample rate in Hz, when known.

sizeBytes.description:
Declared object size in bytes. Rows created before `sizeBytes` became required
on upload may hold 0.

count.description: Number of items in the page.

nextCursor.description:
Present when more history is available. Pass back as `cursor` to fetch the next
page. Only populated when the `categories`/`search`/`dateFrom`/`dateTo`/
`sourceType`/`cursor` pagination path is used.

title: List Audio Files
